We released <strong>GridPath-India</strong>! A capacity expansion and production cost model of the Indian Electricity system. It is based on <a href="https://github.com/blue-marble/gridpath">GridPath</a>, an open-source power-flow modeling platform for Python. You can now download it from our <strong>Dryad</strong> repository
<a href="https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.dz08kpsbm">GridPath India long-term (2020-2050) power system planning model data</a>.
